outcome: Search returns the documents a user is looking for and leaves archived ones out unless they ask.

acceptance_criteria.text: A search matches documents by title and can be narrowed to one owner.

expected_verification.assertion: searching with an owner filter returns only that owner's documents

acceptance_criteria.text: Archived documents are excluded by default and included when the caller asks for them.

expected_verification.assertion: a search without includeArchived returns no archived document, and one with it returns them
